Container.Name: iCloud-Photos-mcp
Container.Overview: Token-free private-network iCloud Photos MCP with persistent Apple sessions. Reads by default; writes and deletes require separate opt-ins. Apple login is completed separately in the container console.

Config.Name: Persistent configuration
Config.Description: Private Apple session; owner 99:100, directory mode 700

Config.Name: Allowed HTTP hosts
Config.Description: Explicit private hostnames/IPs accepted by MCP; comma-separated

Config.Name: Allowed source networks
Config.Description: Trusted LAN, Tailscale and loopback source ranges; comma-separated CIDRs

Config.Name: Enable writes
Config.Description: 1 enables explicitly requested writes; tool dry runs remain the default

Config.Name: Enable deletes
Config.Description: 1 additionally enables deletion tools; write gate is also required
